newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet to supply equipment to Irving Paper.
newsitem.headline: Valmet to supply equipment to Irving Paper.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would deliver equipment for the rebuilding of Canadian Irving Paper Inc's newsprint machine at Saint John, Brunswick mill.
It did not give the value of the order.
"Valmet offered to Irving Paper a solution which allows for the newsprint machine's product selection to be widened to the more refined SC (super-calendered) paper grades," it said.
SC grades are used for magazines and catalogues.
Valmet said the multi-roll calendar it would deliver to Irving Paper "heralded a new era in papermaking".
The integration of the calendar into the paper machine would save time and reduce process stages as re-reeling from one piece of equipment was eliminated, it said.
"The line's efficiency is improved and the run-through time shortened," Valmet said, noting the multi-roll calendar was running at the same speed as the paper machine.
The order by Irving Paper was the first for the integrated calendar equipment launched by Valmet in spring, it said.
